verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skills that the user invokes and runs in sequence. Shipping is gated on the user saying go. Nothing in the evidence shows background, scheduled or autonomous automations. The reminder emails in /replica-backend belong to the generated clone app, not to the product itself, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
